findings.body:
**Preserve `parentWorkId` on `job-finished` events.**

`JobFinishedJournalEventSchema` accepts `parentWorkId`. The replay re-attestation omits `prior.parentWorkId`, and the governed finish omits `correlation.parentWorkId`. A resumed journal can therefore lose the parent link.

<details>
<summary>Suggested fix</summary>

```diff
         ...(correlation !== undefined ? { workId: correlation.workId } : {}),
+        ...(correlation?.parentWorkId !== undefined
+          ? { parentWorkId: correlation.parentWorkId }
+          : {}),
         ...(correlation !== undefined ? { role: correlation.role } : {}),
```

```diff
               ...(prior.workId !== undefined ? { workId: prior.workId } : {}),
+              ...(prior.parentWorkId !== undefined
+                ? { parentWorkId: prior.parentWorkId }
+                : {}),
               ...(prior.role !== undefined ? { role: prior.role } : {}),
```

</details>
